query:
SELECT u.id, u.openId, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.createdAt,
       lc.id AS credId, lc.email AS credEmail, lc.failedAttempts, lc.lockedUntil, lc.mustChangePassword
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN localCredentials lc ON lc.userId = u.id
ORDER BY u.id;
